_comment: Hand-known vessel names, merged on top of whatever the log archive yields.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. tools/build_vessel_names.mjs derives names from Type 5/24
broadcasts in the recordings. 59 of 824 vessels in the archive (7.2%) never
broadcast a name at all, so no amount of listening will ever resolve them. A
name typed into the browser lands in localStorage, which is per-browser and
per-device; a name hand-edited into static/vessel_names.json is wiped by the
next rebuild. This file is the durable place: committed, merged at build time,
Entries here WIN over the archive, because a human looked it up and the AIS
payload may be garbled. Keep it small and keep it sourced — note where the
name came from so the next person can re-check it.
